# @codemirror/streamparser [![NPM version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@codemirror/streamparser.svg)](https://www.npmjs.org/package/@codemirror/streamparser)

[ [**WEBSITE**](https://codemirror.net/) | [**DOCS**](https://codemirror.net/docs/ref/#language) | [**ISSUES**](https://code.haverbeke.berlin/codemirror/dev/issues) | [**FORUM**](https://discuss.codemirror.net/) | [**CHANGELOG**](https://code.haverbeke.berlin/codemirror/streamparser/src/branch/main/CHANGELOG.md) ]

This package exports the abstractions used by stream parser like those
in the `@codemirror/legacy-modes` package.

The [project page](https://codemirror.net/) has more information, a
number of [examples](https://codemirror.net/examples/) and the
[documentation](https://codemirror.net/docs/).
